title: Icicles
description: Adds another dimension to waterlogged dripstone, turning them into icicles.
body:
Waterlogged dripstone will now turn into three dimensional icicles. This is intended to be used with [UnduGT's 3D Pointed Dripstone](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/undopia-3d-pointed-dripstone). 

The textures for the icicle is all thanks to [this pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/3d-pointed-dripstone-for-frostiful), which is meant for [Frostiful](https://modrinth.com/mod/frostiful), though this works completely in vanilla. Looks best in underwater dripstone caves.
